questions.question: An agent summarises web pages. A page contains hidden text that tells the model to ignore its rules. Which risk is this?

options.why: Correct. The instructions are hidden in content the model reads, not typed by the user.
A jailbreak is typed by the user in the prompt.
Rate limits concern throughput.
Drift concerns changes in quality over time.

questions.explanation: Prompt Shields detect user prompt attacks and indirect attacks.

questions.question: Which intervention point should a control use to inspect the content returned by an external tool before the model uses it?

options.why: Correct. It checks what a tool returned, which is where indirect attacks arrive.
This checks the user prompt only.
This checks the final answer, which is later.
This is not an intervention point.

questions.explanation: The four intervention points are user input, tool call, tool response and output.

questions.scenario: A team adds a new guardrail control and wants to see what it would catch before it affects users.
questions.question: Which action should it choose?

options.why: Correct. Annotate records detections without blocking content.
This blocks content immediately.
This removes the control.
This stops the application.

questions.question: What does a Foundry guardrail contain?

options.text: A set of controls combining a risk, an intervention point and an action
options.why: Correct. This is the structure of a guardrail.
Deployments are what a guardrail attaches to.
Network rules are separate from guardrails.
Billing alerts are separate.

questions.explanation: Controls define what is detected, where and what happens.

questions.question: Answers must not reveal customer card numbers. Which control should you add?

options.text: A PII control at the output intervention point
options.why: Correct. It detects personal data in the model response before the user sees it.
Temperature does not detect data.
Context size does not detect data.

options.text: A tool response control for violence only
options.why: This checks a different risk at a different point.

questions.explanation: Use PII detection where the data could leave.
